referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process models 1 meter cantilever retaining wall with a height of 5.4 meters. Production phase (A1–A3) and construction phase/ transport (A4–A5) for 1 meter of installed cantiliever retaining wall, as well as trench excavation, foundation and backfilling are included. Disposal and deconstruction processes are excluded and modelled separately. Service life time 50 years
